parts.title: The spare key — part 1
parts.story_so_far: A missing key leads to a surprise birthday cake.

post.title: My neighbor returned my missing key.

lines.text: My neighbor returned my missing key in a sealed envelope.
Inside, she had written a warning: check the blue cupboard.
I reached for the cupboard door, and someone knocked behind me.

parts.title: The spare key — part 2
parts.story_so_far: A missing key leads to a surprise birthday cake.

post.title: The warning led to a birthday surprise.

lines.text: The blue cupboard held the birthday cake I thought nobody remembered.
My neighbor stood at the kitchen door with my sister and three candles.
The warning was a joke, but I finally knew who had borrowed my spare key.
